content.rendered:
nEdge

Gateway with policies and bandwidth control. Needs two wired interfaces.

Choose your system

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y software-properties-common wget
sudo add-apt-repository -y universe
wget https://packages.ntop.org/apt-stable/24.04/all/apt-ntop-stable.deb
sudo apt install -y ./apt-ntop-stable.deb
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y nedge

nEdge changes your network. Use a dedicated machine.

Open http://YOUR-IP:3000. Login: admin / admin.

In System Setup, choose Bridge (easy) or Router, pick the LAN and WAN interfaces, then apply.

Next steps

nEdge product page
nEdge guide
